newsitem.title: USA: Accent Software sees loss, to offer shrs.
newsitem.headline: Accent Software sees loss, to offer shrs.

text.p: Accent Software International Ltd it expects to report revenues for the three months period ended September 30 of between $500,000 and $1.0 million and a net loss of between $5.7 and $6.0 million.

The company said, "Due to the change in overall market conditions and our second quarter results, the Company found it necessary to delay and restructure its proposed offering which was previously announced in July, 1996. This delay and the resultant cash shortage, among other things, contributed to the disappointing third quarter results and will adversely affect the fourth quarter results. However, we have maintained focus on product development throughout this period, and have generally continued to maintain our product development schedules."
The company also said it planned to sell 1.5 million ordinary shares and 1.5 redeemable warrants.

In connection with the proposed offering, IMR Fund L.P, the largest shareholder, has committed to provide interim financing until the company's proposed financing is complete, of up to $1.5 million ($675,000 of which has already been advanced) and has agreed to purchase up to 148,500 ordinary shares and up to 148,500 redeemable warrants being offered in the proposed offering, at a purchase price no more than $1.5 million.
Sands Brothers & Co Ltd would be lead underwriter

In addition, the Board of Directors has elected Roger Cloutier, currently a director of the Company, to serve as chairman. It is expected that Cloutier will work closely with management to ensure the implementation of its revised operating and financial management plans.
In addition, the company has engaged Merrill Lynch to act as a financial adviser with respect to seeking strategic investors, joint venture partners or other persons to invest
